name: labelActivity
description: Sensitivity label activity (applied, changed, removed, opened and more), grouped by the dimensions you choose: time, user, label, previous label, action, activity, application and site (needs Defender for Cloud Apps with the Microsoft 365 connector)

postBody.Query:
let binSize = {{ (new Date(timeframe.end) - new Date(timeframe.start)) <= 86400000 ? '1h' : '1d' }};
let selectedLabels = dynamic({{ JSON.stringify((labels || []).map(o => [].concat(o.rawId)[0]).filter(Boolean).map(s => String(s).toLowerCase())) }});
let selectedUsers = dynamic({{ JSON.stringify((users || []).map(o => [].concat(o.rawId)[0]).filter(Boolean).map(s => String(s).toLowerCase())) }});
let selectedSites = dynamic({{ JSON.stringify((sites || []).map(o => [].concat(o.rawId)[0]).filter(Boolean).map(s => String(s).toLowerCase())) }});
let selectedActions = dynamic({{ JSON.stringify((typeof actions === 'undefined' || !actions ? [] : [].concat(actions)).map((m) => (m && typeof m === 'object' ? m.value : m)).filter((m) => ['Detected in email', 'Applied', 'Changed', 'Upgraded', 'Downgraded', 'Removed', 'Opened', 'Renamed', 'Change failed'].includes(m))) }});
let agg = materialize(CloudAppEvents
| where Timestamp between (datetime({{timeframe.start}}) .. datetime({{timeframe.end}}))
| where ActionType contains 'SensitivityLabel' or ActionType == 'MipLabel'
| where AccountType != 'Application'
| where array_length(selectedUsers) == 0 or set_has_element(selectedUsers, tolower(AccountObjectId))
| extend raw = todynamic(RawEventData)
| extend led = raw.SensitivityLabelEventData
| extend wLabel = tolower(coalesce(tostring(led.SensitivityLabelId), tostring(raw.LabelId))), wPrev = tolower(tostring(led.OldSensitivityLabelId)), eventType = tostring(led.LabelEventType)
| where isnotempty(wLabel) or isnotempty(wPrev)
| where array_length(selectedLabels) == 0 or set_has_element(selectedLabels, wLabel) or set_has_element(selectedLabels, wPrev)
| extend wSite = tolower(trim_end('/', tostring(raw.SiteUrl)))
| where array_length(selectedSites) == 0 or set_has_element(selectedSites, wSite)
| extend hasPrevious = isnotempty(wPrev)
| extend wAction = case(
    ActionType contains 'ChangeFailed', 'Change failed',
    ActionType endswith 'Removed', 'Removed',
    ActionType == 'SensitivityLabeledFileOpened', 'Opened',
    ActionType == 'SensitivityLabeledFileRenamed', 'Renamed',
    ActionType == 'MipLabel', 'Detected in email',
    isempty(wLabel), 'Removed',
    hasPrevious and eventType == '1', 'Upgraded',
    hasPrevious and eventType == '2', 'Downgraded',
    hasPrevious and eventType == '3', 'Removed',
    hasPrevious or eventType == '4' or ActionType endswith 'Changed' or ActionType endswith 'Updated', 'Changed',
    'Applied')
| where array_length(selectedActions) == 0 or set_has_element(selectedActions, wAction)
